d.ko:
"Business Tour" is a free to play  multiplayer tabletop game.
Play with up to 3 friends in online mode. Or single player in offline mode.
Complete daily tasks,  compete against the other players and receive trade items rewards!
d.en: Business Tour is a free-to-play multiplayer tabletop game. Build your own monopoly, play with friends, complete daily tasks, and compete against players from around the world. Easy to learn, fun to master, and perfect for quick matches.
d.zh:
“商业之旅”是一款免费多人桌面游戏。
您可以与最多 3 位朋友在线游戏，或在离线模式下单人游戏。
完成每日任务，与其他玩家竞争，获得交易物品奖励！
